reuse.why: Routes every planning site (preview, posting, action sync, forecast, schedule templates, API list, client tables and balances) through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes four inline copies of the midpoint/missing-amount dispatch and replaces them with the shared helper; no new copies are introduced.

placement.why: The worst-case rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the one function server and client already shared, and the API exposes it by calling that function.

scope.why: Focused on amount resolution, the API field and tests; the shared helper's semantics also change for the schedule editor's operator-switch conversion in useScheduleEdit.ts, which is not a planning use.

maintainability.why: One explicit op parameter carries the variation and the rule is in one place, though inserting op before the existing inverse positional argument and repurposing the helper used by the editor needs care.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter (placed before inverse) and an isapprox branch; all planning call sites now use it
